name: ultimate-marketing-skills
description: Ultimate Marketing Skills (UMS for Claude). Market apps, games, websites, SaaS, developer tools and local businesses the social-first way, on one route from brief to published post: an advisor that picks the tactic ladder for the project type, hours and budget; native short-form video built from a storyboard with ffmpeg (captions, push-ins, ducked voiceover, -14 LUFS) and checked against TikTok, Reels and Shorts limits; ad-library and trend research; copy that does not read as AI-written; and an approval queue with four autonomy modes, from advice only to autopilot that publishes approved X and Bluesky posts on schedule. Claude in Chrome fills the composer for every other platform and a person presses publish.
